description:
Hushfeed v0.50.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

The Hushfeed entry is first again in TikTok's Settings and privacy page. Failed local feed actions now report the error instead of showing false success or Undo feedback. Concurrent setting writes can't roll a newer value back, movable feed controls stay inside changing safe areas, and large translated headings keep whole words at enlarged text sizes. Feature Gate Lab search now ranks work away from TikTok's UI thread and cancels stale searches.

Validation: 1471 runtime tests passed locally, plus 243 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. Every patch applied with zero failures to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with no unexpected manifest changes. The exact release-derived APK was installed over the same-signer build on the S22. It matched the installed pull byte for byte, kept the account signed in and preserved the original first-install time. A second Samsung S25 pass on its separately signed Hushfeed 0.46.0 installation confirmed first-row placement, dark settings, search and Back behavior on TikTok 47.0.3. The exact v0.50.0 APK wasn't installed because the Manager signing key differs, and no app data was removed.

The strict Feature Gate Lab frame trace still found 8 of 15 app frames above 16.67 ms. TikTok kept the tested feed activity in portrait when landscape was requested, so landscape overlay coverage remains open. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
